Economic Survey.about: Annual document reviewing the performance of the Indian economy and suggesting policy measures.
Economic Survey.importance: Highly important for UPSC Prelims and Mains. Questions are asked on growth trends, inflation, fiscal policy, sectors and reforms.
Economic Survey.published_by: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

Union Budget.about: The Union Budget is the annual financial statement of the Government of India presenting estimated receipts and expenditures for a financial year.
Union Budget.importance: Extremely important for UPSC Prelims and Mains. Questions are asked on fiscal deficit, taxation, government schemes, sectoral allocations and economic policy direction.
Union Budget.published_by: Ministry of Finance, Government of India

World Economic Outlook.about: A flagship report of the IMF that provides analysis and projections of global economic growth, inflation, trade and financial conditions.
World Economic Outlook.importance: Very important for UPSC Prelims and Mains. Questions are asked on global growth trends, inflation outlook, recession risks and comparison of economies.
